newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SEASON OVER FOR FIORENTINA'S SCHWARZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SEASON OVER FOR FIORENTINA'S SCHWARZ.

text.p: Fiorentina's Stefan Schwarz will miss the rest of this season's serie A championship after fracturing a shin in Sweden's World Cup match against Scotland, the Italian club said on Thursday.

A doctor who inspected the player on his return to Italy after Wednesday's 2-1 win for Sweden in Gothenburg said the injury was slight but that at best Schwarz could expect the fracture to mend in around 20 days.
"The recovery will be very quick but the championship is definitely over for him," said doctor Giorgio Galante.
The serie A championship ends on June 1. Fiorentina, beaten European Cup Winners' Cup semifinalists, are ninth.
